l-m-e4-b04-27.material: Kana tambo tsvuku ine kureba 1.4 m netambo yebhuruu ine kureba 0.75 m dzikabatanidzwa mumutsetse mumwe, tinoda kuwana kuti pane m dzakawanda sei pamwe chete. Chinja nyaya iyi kuita equation.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.a: Kubatanidza kunoita kuti kureba kuwedzere, saka hakusi kubvisa.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.r.d: 0.75 yakakopwa zvisina kururama se7.5. Poindi yedhesimali iri pane imwe nzvimbo.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s1.explain: Kana ukabatanidza tambo mbiri, unowedzera kureba. 1.4+0.75=2.15, saka i2.15 m.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Kubatanidza tambo kunoita kuti dzive nekureba kwenhamba mbiri dzakaiswa pamwe chete, saka unogona kunyora 1.4+0.75.
l-m-e4-b04-27.s.s2.model.1: 0.75 m inowedzerwa kukureba kwekutanga kwe1.4 m, saka equation yekuwedzera 1.4+0.75 inoreva chinhu chimwe chete nenyaya.

l-m-e4-b04-28.title: Kutaura "perpendicular" nemamwe mazwi
l-m-e4-b04-28.goal: Chinja chirevo chekuti "mitsetse miviri yakatwasuka iri perpendicular kuna mumwe nemumwe" kuita imwe nzira yekuratidza (equation, tebhulo, mufananidzo, mazwi), uye utsanangure kuti zvinoreva chinhu chimwe chete sei.
l-m-e4-b04-28.material: Mutsetse A nemutsetse B zviri perpendicular kuna mumwe nemumwe. Tinoda kunyora izvi zvakare nemamwe mazwi anoreva chinhu chimwe chete.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.prompt: Chirevo chipi chinoreva chinhu chimwe chete?
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.a: Mitsetse miviri inosangana ichiita kona yakarurama
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.o.b: Mitsetse miviri inosangana ichiita kona yakakura
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Inofanira kuita kona yakarurama, kwete kona yakakura, kuti ive perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.c: Mitsetse miviri isingasangani iri parallel. Haisi perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: Mutsetse wakatwasuka hauna kureba kwakatarwa, uye kureba hakuna chekuita nekuva perpendicular.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s1.explain: Kana kona inoitwa nemitsetse miviri inosangana iri kona yakarurama, tinoti iri perpendicular kuna mumwe nemumwe.
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.0: "Perpendicular" zvinoreva kuti kona inoitwa panosangana mitsetse miviri iri kona yakarurama, saka yakafanana ne"kusangana uchiita kona yakarurama."
l-m-e4-b04-28.s.s2.model.1: Mitsetse miviri inosangana pachikamu chimwe uye kona i90°, saka inzira imwe yekutaura "perpendicular."

l-m-e4-b04-30.title: Kutaura "equilateral triangle" maererano nemakona
l-m-e4-b04-30.goal: Chinja "tiranguru ine mativi ose matatu ane kureba kwakaenzana" kuita imwe nzira yekuratidza (equation, tebhulo, mufananidzo, mazwi), uye utsanangure kuti zvinoreva chinhu chimwe chete sei.
l-m-e4-b04-30.material: Tiranguru ine mativi ose 3 ane kureba kwakaenzana iequilateral triangle. Tinoda kutaura izvi maererano nehukuru hwemakona panzvimbo pemativi.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Chirevo chipi chinochinja tsananguro yeequilateral triangle kuita makona?
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Huwandu hwemakona 3 i180°, saka haagone kuva 90° rimwe nerimwe.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Kana pane kona yakarurama, kureba kwemativi hakugone kuva kwakaenzana.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.r.d: Muequilateral triangle, makona ose 3 akaenzana, kwete maviri chete.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Kana mativi ose 3 akaenzana, makona ose 3 akaenzana futi, uye huwandu hwawo i180°, saka kona imwe i180°÷3=60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Kana mativi ose 3 akaenzana, makona 3 akaenzana uye anowedzera kusvika 180°, saka kona imwe i60°.
l-m-e4-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Equilateral triangle inofanira kuva nemakona 3 akaenzana, saka inoreva chinhu chimwe chete netiranguru ine makona e180°÷3=60° rimwe nerimwe.

l-m-e4-b05-26.goal: Taura zvakare chimiro chakagadzirwa nekutendeuka mufananidzo kurudyi nenzira imwe (chirevo, tebhulo, mufananidzo, kana mazwi), uye utsanangure kuti zvinoreva chinhu chimwe chete sei.
l-m-e4-b05-26.material: Mufananidzo wakatendeurwa kurudyi. Unoda kuwana, nemazwi, imwe kufamba kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete nekutendeuka.

l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: Kutendeuka kumusoro kunochinja kumusoro nepazasi, saka kunosiyana nechimiro chakachinjana kuruboshwe nekurudyi.

l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: Chimiro chakaunzurwa kurudyi nechimiro chakaunzurwa kuruboshwe zvose zvine kuruboshwe nerudyi zvakachinjana, saka zvakafanana.
l-m-e4-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: Pamucheto upi zvawo paunoundura, kuruboshwe nerudyi zvinochinjana, saka chimiro chakafanana nekuunzura kuruboshwe.

l-m-e4-b05-30.title: Kunyora zvakare bar graph setafura
l-m-e4-b05-30.material: Pane bar graph umo sikweya imwe yechiyero inomirira mabhuku 3. Marefu emabara A, B, C, ne D ndisikweya 4, sikweya 6, sikweya 5, nesikweya 2. Nyora zvakare graph iyi setafura munhamba dzemabhuku.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi tafura inoratidza zvakafanana negraph? (nenhevedzano A, B, C, D)
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.a: Nhamba yemasikweya yakanyorwa senhamba yemabhuku. Sikweya imwe ndi mabhuku 3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: 3 yakawedzerwa panhamba yemasikweya. Unofanira kuwanza ne3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinotora sikweya imwe seyemabhuku 4. Sikweya imwe ndi mabhuku 3.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Sikweya imwe ndi mabhuku 3, saka wanza nhamba yemasikweya ne3. 4×3=12, 6×3=18, 5×3=15, 2×3=6.
l-m-e4-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: Sikweya imwe ndi mabhuku 3, saka kuwanza nhamba yemasikweya ne3 kunopa mabhuku 12, mabhuku 18, mabhuku 15, nemabhuku 6, izvo zvinowirirana negraph.
